name: Interfere API
description: Register builds, ingest telemetry, and inspect application issues. Build operations authenticate with a secret surface key; SDK ingestion uses a publishable surface key. Dashboard operations require a Clerk session, and investigation endpoints require workload identity. Authentication alternatives are listed on each operation. Retry only when the operation contract permits it, preserving the original idempotency key.
